(4 marks)","q_type":"difference","marks":4,"blocks":[{"type":"compare_table","headers":["Distance","Displacement"],"rows":[["It is the total path length covered by a moving object.","It is the shortest straight line length between the starting point and the ending point."],["It has no direction, it is a scalar quantity.","It has a direction, it is a vector quantity."],["It can never be zero if the object moves.","It can be zero even if the object moves, when it returns to the start."],["Its value is always equal to or greater than displacement.","Its value is always equal to or less than distance."]]}],"keywords":["total path length","shortest straight line length","scalar quantity","vector quantity"],"diagram":{"template":"path_vs_straight","params":{"path_length":10,"straight_length":6,"unit":"m"}},"unit_direction_note":"దూరం (Distance) కి దిశ ఉండదు, స్థానభ్రంశం (Displacement) కి దిశ ఉంటుంది అని నువ్వు గుర్తుపెట్టుకో.","concept_key":"c5-science-distance-vs-displacement","scene_prompt":"A child walks around a curved park path then returns to a point closer to start, shown with a straight arrow."}]}
